card.name: Decimal points in section numbers
card.fires_on: The period or slash right after a leading section number, such as the dot in 2.1, 5.8 or 6.2, in cross-references and headings. It also fires on the digit just before that point.

modes.label: Dot in section references
modes.description: The period between the two parts of a numbered section cited in parentheses or brackets.

modes.label: Dot in section headings
modes.description: The period after the chapter number at the start of a numbered heading.

modes.label: Number before the dot
modes.description: A digit or slash in a document or resolution number just before the numbered part.

card.plain: It marks the dot inside a section number like 2.1 or 5.8, as used in label cross-references and headings.
